constructor.details: Validates all addresses are non-zero and contracts where expected.      Grants ADMIN_ROLE and EMERGENCY_ROLE to deployer and project wallet.

params._bashoodToken: Address of the BHT ERC20 token contract
params._maxNFTSupply: Maximum number of NFTs available in presale
params._nftContract: Address of the ERC1155 NFT contract
params._nftPriceBHT: Price per NFT in BHT tokens (18 decimals)
params._projectWallet: Payable address for project fund collection

getRoleAdmin(bytes32).details: Returns the admin role that controls `role`. See {grantRole} and {revokeRole}. To change a role's admin, use {_setRoleAdmin}.

grantRole(bytes32,address).details: Grants `role` to `account`. If `account` had not been already granted `role`, emits a {RoleGranted} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleGranted} event.

paused().details: Returns true if the contract is paused, and false otherwise.

purchaseWithBHT(uint256,uint256,uint256,.details: Applies BHT discount and burn. Validates supply, user limits, and signature.

params.nftId: The ID of the NFT to purchase
params.nonce: Unique nonce for signature replay protection
params.signature: ECDSA signature from the authorized signer

purchaseWithETH(uint256,uint256,uint256,.details: Validates signature, nonce, supply limits, and user limits. Awards referral if applicable.

params.nftId: The ID of the NFT to purchase (must be in allowedNftIds)
params.nonce: Unique nonce for signature replay protection
params.signature: ECDSA signature from the authorized signer

renounceRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from the calling account. Roles are often managed via {grantRole} and {revokeRole}: this function's purpose is to provide a mechanism for accounts to lose their privileges if they are compromised (such as when a trusted device is misplaced). If the calling account had been revoked `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must be `callerConfirmation`. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

params.tokenAddress: Address of the ERC20 token to rescue

params.nftId: ID of the NFT to rescue

revokeRole(bytes32,address).details: Revokes `role` from `account`. If `account` had been granted `role`, emits a {RoleRevoked} event. Requirements: - the caller must have ``role``'s admin role. May emit a {RoleRevoked} event.

params.newStaleness: Maximum age in seconds for oracle prices

setRescueContract(address).details: Validates that the contract implements IBashoodRescue via ERC165.

params.whitelistEnabled_: true to require WHITELIST_ROLE for buyers

assignRoles(address,address,address).notice: Assign admin, emergency, and whitelist roles to addresses

emergencyWithdrawETH().notice: Emergency withdrawal of ETH to the project wallet. Emergency role only.

endPresale().notice: Deactivate the presale without emitting an event. Admin only.

finalizePresale().notice: Finalize the presale and emit PresaleFinalized event. Admin only.

rescueERC20(address,address,uint256).notice: Rescue ERC20 tokens accidentally sent to the contract. Admin only.

rescueUnsoldNFTs(uint256,address,uint256.notice: Rescue unsold NFTs from the presale contract. Admin only.
